title: Settings Section

story.introduction:
Day 6 on planet Syntax-IV. The ship's core systems are stable, but now we need to configure the diagnostic framework itself.

MENTOR-9: "PROTO-7, we've mastered basic tests and validation. Now it's time to learn the Settings section - the control panel of every test suite."

"Settings configure how your tests run: lifecycle hooks, timeouts, library imports, and more. Think of it as the mission briefing before each diagnostic scan."
story.context: The *** Settings *** section is where you configure suite-level behavior: setup/teardown procedures, default tags, test timeouts, and library imports. It's the foundation of organized test automation.

learningObjectives: Use Suite Setup and Suite Teardown hooks
Apply Test Setup and Test Teardown for individual tests
Implement Default Tags for test organization
Set Test Timeout to prevent infinite loops
Master settings syntax flexibility (spacing, header variations)
